import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'], capture_output=True, text=True)
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'm3: Support callable into in @reraise'], capture_output=True, text=True)

# Verify commits
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Commits on top of base:")
print(result.stdout)
